name: capture2text
description: Tesseract OCR tool for screen capture and image text extraction

tools.description: GUI OCR tool with hotkey screen capture and multi-language support
tools.usage:
Capture2Text.exe # Launch OCR GUI with hotkey configuration
Windows Key + Q # Default hotkey for screen text capture
Alt + Q # Capture text and read aloud with TTS
Configure languages and OCR settings in GUI
Supports Japanese, Chinese, German, French, and 100+ languages

tools.description: Command-line OCR for batch text extraction from images
tools.usage:
Capture2Text_CLI.exe -i image.png -o text.txt # Extract text to file
Capture2Text_CLI.exe --lang jpn -i japanese.jpg # Japanese OCR
Capture2Text_CLI.exe --whitelist "0123456789" -i digits.png # Extract only numbers
Capture2Text_CLI.exe --scale-factor 2 -i small_text.png # Scale up for better OCR
Capture2Text_CLI.exe --show-conf -i scan.jpg # Show confidence scores
